There's a right way and a wrong way to play this game. If done right, you either have an army of drones, overpowered attacks, or so many chance-on-hit items that you get a new effect every second. Heck, even all three. Do it wrong, and you end up either dying on the first level, or making it to the final level and end up getting 'rekt' by the countless amounts of enemies. I'm talking about YOU, jellyfishes. With a multitude of items and characters to unlock with new updates periodically, it's hard to not remember and go back to Risk of Rain. 

The core of the game that makes it different from the rest of it's rogue-like cousins is the fact that time equals money. Erm, read that wrong, time equals difficulty. There we go. The more time you spend, the harder the game gets, which provides two basic methods of beating the game. Going Rambo past all the stages, barely collecting any items, or going Juggernaut and end up letting your items and upgrades do the tanking for you. But feel free to come up with your own method, though I prefer the beefy 'build-an-impenetrable defense' route. 

The 2D pixelated art style isn't relatively new, in fact, one might say it's pretty retro, bad jokes aside, but it adds a sense of nostalgia that most games don't have, though I do admit, a lot of titles are going along with the 8-bit theme. The sound track is also amazing, giving a nostalgic feel while also allowing for heart-pumping boss battle music. Each level has 2 to 3 different of itself as well, providing a different feeling while still maintain the same enemies and color palette for that level. 

In the recent update, artifacts were added, further customizing how the game is played. Some artifacts are harder to find than others, while some are better than others, like the Glass artifact with makes you have 500% increased damage at the cost of health. Overall, tons of variety to make you keep wanting more. There is even an item log and monster log, so you can learn the lore of each of the monsters and items, my personal favorite item log being the Rotten Brain, pretty humorous. 

Risk of Rain is an overall amazing game with great nostalgic graphics, amazing sound track, and tons of replay ability. No matter if you're young, old, big, small, or just bored on Steam and have a few bucks laying around, Risk of Rain is sure to fill your video game and boredom needs.

Damn this game is good. Excellent mechanics, fun graphics, a great items system, lots of unlockables and hidden extras for hours of gameplay. Plus it's multiplayer is pretty solid. The difficulty curve is steep and it can get frustrating at times but I always ended up having a good time. It has a couple of glitches here and there but nothing game-breaking. Very much worth the 10 dollars.
Edit: Also a fantastic soundtrack.

This game is amazing. Countless hours of fun gameplay; the artifacts add a whole other layer to the vanilla game as well! Some would say RoR is a bit easy after you've mastered the game, but honestly, it's an amazing feeling when you become a super-omega-death-god with 20 turrets raining fire and hell on the twelve bosses all trying to shut you down. Loads of fun, give it a try!
